developments.title: Octo foundation model
developments.summary: Octo is an open-source generalist robot policy trained on 800k trajectories using a transformer diffusion architecture.

claims.text: Octo models are transformer-based diffusion policies trained on a diverse mix of 800k robot trajectories.

developments.title: Pi0 general-purpose robot foundation model
developments.summary: Pi0 combines a large vision-language model backbone (initialized from PaliGemma) with a diffusion transformer action expert for vision-language-action robotics.

claims.text: Pi0 integrates a large vision-language model backbone initialized from PaliGemma with a diffusion transformer action expert for vision-language-action robotics.

developments.title: SPEAR-1 European open-weight robotics foundation model
developments.summary: SPEAR-1 is the first European open-weight robotic foundation model that achieves state-of-the-art performance using 20× less robot data by leveraging non-robotic 3D data.

claims.text: SPEAR-1 is the first European-made open-weight robotic AI foundation model and outperforms existing state-of-the-art models while using 20x less robotic data.

developments.title: MolmoAct 2 open-source robotics foundation model
developments.summary: MolmoAct 2 is an open-source vision‑language‑action model released by AI2 in 2026, with code, data, and training recipe publicly available and integrated into Hugging Face’s LeRobot platform.

claims.text: MolmoAct 2 code, data, and training recipe were released publicly in May 2026, enabling open‑source use and integration with Hugging Face’s LeRobot platform.

dropped: ACT (Action Chunk Transformer) open-source robot foundation model
